title: Cyprus reservoir storage
attribution: Water Development Department, Republic of Cyprus. Adapted from the national open data portal.
method: Reshape three columns from the published CSV. Use the observation dates printed in the file. Keep measured zeroes. Omit empty cells and conflicting values for the same reservoir and date. Collapse identical duplicate values. Sort by date. No estimates or interpolation.

quality.gapDescription: Each gap lists the observed dates on either side of an interval longer than 25 days.
